Option A ("Fifty-four ninetieths only") fails because it leaves as unreduced fraction; Option B ("Two fifths of the movement") fails because it treats "Two fifths of the movement" as if it followed from the evidence; Option D ("One half of the movement") fails because it rounds incorrectly.
